title: Power Gen Xtra Oil, Men's Wellness Support Oil, 30ml Dropper Bottle
description: Power Gen Xtra Oil is a specially formulated men's wellness support oil designed to enhance vitality and vigour. This Ayurvedic proprietary product comes in a convenient 30ml dropper bottle for easy application. The formulation contains a carefully selected blend of traditional ingredients including Jaitun oil (Olive oil), Jaiphal oil (Nutmeg oil), Javitri (Mace), Heart wood, Rosemary Leaves, Vatada oil (Seed oil), Nutmeg, Dalchini (Cinnamon), Lavanga (Clove), Twak Bark, Keshariya Stigma, Ashwagandha Root, and Til oil (Seed oil). This unique combination of natural ingredients has been thoughtfully crafted to support men's overall wellness. The dropper bottle design allows for precise and controlled application, making it user-friendly and practical. Power Gen Xtra Oil is suitable for men seeking a natural approach to wellness support. The 30ml size makes it perfect for regular use whilst remaining compact and portable. Experience the benefits of this traditional formulation that combines time-tested ingredients in a modern, convenient format.
